owner: Mac handoff routed by Ben all-ticket request; lead owns independent preregistration review

recipe.input: Exact committed repository-root index.scip and source .proto/generated .pb.go/consumer .go bytes. No managed generation or navigation authority substitution.
recipe.evaluation_revision: Local evaluator Git commits/bundles contain exact committed source plus produced index. Upstream source revision is provenance only; evaluation.local repo labels prevent false upstream commit authority.

populations.generation_provenance: Unmodified upstream committed .pb.go; exact header-reported versions. No claim to have regenerated old public bytes.
Generated locally from frozen authored .proto with pinned tools; supplementary contract controls, not public quality evidence.

labels.enumerator: cmd/enumerate/main.go: Go AST selectors plus identifier composite-literal keys, no SCIP/phebs imports or outputs
labels.derivation: Source receiver/literal type and exact source .proto numeric ID manually labelled before index creation. All enumerated sites retained; non-field package/type/method/ordinary-Go fields are negatives.
labels.independent_declarations_derivation: Existing spike/t491 independent lexer/parser over frozen proto bytes, with manually source-checked names, numeric IDs and unsupported oneof labels. No protodecl/scipfield output.

identity.field_object: Fully-qualified source protobuf message + # + numeric field ID; renames retain ID; generated Go spelling alone is insufficient.
identity.bridge: The two lineage families remain distinct. Only within one exact repo/commit/source+SCIP snapshot, join a unique source DECLARES_FIELD object to its exact generated file/tag and header source path plus exact SCIP definition and global symbol package. Record proto/generated/index digests and declaration span; no join on bare names or lineage equality. This spike proves witnesses, not a production cross-family reader.
identity.package_identity: SCIP package name is the Go module (not the generated import path); version is detail only, not package-family hash. The exact generated import/type/identifier definition remains a required witness.
identity.ambiguous: Missing, conflicting or multiple proto roots/field candidates/definition bindings abstain. Cross-repo/commit/path/index/digest, changed source, or mismatched family cannot share a bridge.
identity.descriptor: Decode exact generated raw FileDescriptorProto and compare source-name/message/field-number/name census independently with frozen source declaration oracle; synthetic map-entry message is not a source declaration.

supported: Go proto3 Open API direct tagged struct field selector and composite-literal key
Exact generated Get<Field> call or method value, bound to the same generated receiver/tag
Proto3 optional, repeated, map and nested message direct fields are covered by separate neutral controls
excluded: Reflection/protoreflect field-name lookup and runtime dynamicpb messages
Unknown/wire bytes, oneof wrapper fields and getters without a directly tagged parent field
Opaque/Hybrid API, Editions/proto2/extensions, unpinned generators/indexers/languages, missing generated sources or uncommitted/managed SCIP

Semantic read/write inference: classification reports exact raw SCIP role precedence write > read > test > generated > unknown. Assignments may be reported as read by scip-go; no semantic write-accuracy claim.

metrics.scope: Separate exhaustive finite public and neutral consumer-path populations. Count every emitted reference on either consumer path, including any span outside source-only enumeration. Generated-file emissions are reported separately and never mixed into quality denominators.
metrics.precision: Exact positive identity+byte citation matches / all consumer-path emissions; duplicates or extras fail.
metrics.recall: Exact positive matches / all independently labelled positive sites (public 14, neutral 17).
metrics.negative: Zero exact consumer emissions at all negative and unsupported sites; public 56 negatives, neutral 7 negatives and 12 unsupported.
metrics.identity_and_citation: 100% of matched facts must carry expected predicate, numeric object, package family, dependency version, exact source digest, byte and line range, exact tier, production role, schema/rule and raw SCIP role classification.
metrics.interpretation: Finite source census only; no sampled confidence, broad generator accuracy, scale, operating, startup/auth/API/UI/MCP, production registration or promotion claim. Public result does not transfer to neutral or other generators.

stop_rules: Any frozen source/index/label/descriptor digest drift stops before scoring.
Independent lead must review preregistration and labels before first extractor run.

Any unsupported input, parse refusal, corpus error, missed positive, extra/duplicate/wrong identity/citation or negative/unsupported emission fails the preregistered result; preserve original labels and report failure rather than repair labels after seeing output.
Any changed recipe/source-label population needs a new preregistration before a new measurement; no retries to manufacture a pass.
